notes.title: Find back the soul of great boardgames in ATRIUM
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34823913/07949b7c1c56034d7383260ab8dd3079f810c9b7.png[/img]

Get ready to wet your feet to protect your territories because ATRIUM will be released on Steam this July 16th, 2019 for 24.99$.

Step back into the ancient Rome in a breathtaking scenery. Gather your friends to play and earn their respect by building the biggest trade road, or building the biggest castle that the world has ever seen. But be careful to protect yourself against the deceivers who are waiting for an opening to steal your properties.
